intuition.title: Study context: Reductive route
intuition.text: The authors propose that Mg reduces WO3 and ethanol to reactive W and C, followed by carbide formation. Equations describe a proposed mechanism; intermediate yields were not measured.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Equations 1–7 and mechanism discussion

intuition.title: Study context: Filling comparison
intuition.text: Higher ethanol filling correlates with fewer other tungsten phases in the source XRD series. The paper attributes this to system pressure without giving pressure measurements.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Filling discussion and Figure 2

intuition.title: Study context: Carbon coating
intuition.text: Excess carbon is proposed to deposit on WC surfaces. Both carbon-coated and carbon-free particles are observed; no uniform coating or population fraction is claimed.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2, Figure 3 and mechanism discussion

general_background.title: Electron transfer from a reductant
general_background.summary: A reducing agent can supply electrons that change the oxidation state of a precursor. Coordination and competing reactions affect how that electron transfer contributes to particle formation.
